summary: Not one of us: {rival} says you are not really from here: your schooling, your money or the years you lived elsewhere.
realLife: One life: Running for an open West Texas House seat in 1978, he was painted by Democrat Kent Hance as out of touch with rural Texans. He lost, the only race he ever lost. Another: A newcomer to Arizona accused of carpetbagging in 1982, he answered at a candidates' forum that the longest he had lived anywhere was Hanoi, as a prisoner of war. He won.
gates: A fact on your record the charge can stand on: schooling elsewhere, a recent move, family money.
weights: How far your background is from the district's.
choices: answer with where you were and why

branches.then: The answer is the service, said once at a forum, and it ends the charge.

branches.when: you were away at school, from money
branches.then: {rival} sets your school beside theirs, and it sticks unless you have something local to point to.
You never let yourself be outdone on roots again, a stance later scenes read.
